Lighthouse Games is a new AAA studio in Leamington Spa. We are defined by our pedigree of talent, and serious ambition to build a new best-in-class game. When you join us at Lighthouse, you will be able to create the best work of your career, in an environment that feels truly collaborative. You will learn from the best, and work along side the future greats of the gaming industry.
 As a QA Tester, you will play a vital role in ensuring the quality and stability of our game. You will be responsible for testing and identifying bugs, working closely with the QA team and other development teams to provide detailed feedback and support in the resolution of issues.

We kindly want to inform you that we are unable to offer VISA sponsorship for this position at the moment. Therefore, candidates should already have eligibility to work in the UK.

• Experience in game testing or a related field 

• Strong knowledge of game testing methodologies and best practices 

• Ability to effectively execute test cases and identify, isolate, and document bugs 

• Good problem-solving and analytical skills 

• Excellent attention to detail 

• Strong communication and collaboration skills 

• Ability to work well in a team 

• Passion for games and game development 

• 25 Days Holiday, plus 1 day for your birthday

• Studio Shutdown between Christmas and New Year

• Discretionary Bonus Scheme

• Private Pension Scheme

• Private Healthcare

• Health and Well-Being Benefits

• Dental Care

• Optical treatments

• Mental Health Support
